audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a crisp mechanical clicking sound representing the unscrewing of a bottle cap. A light, mid-tempo lo-fi background track with a prominent electronic beat and warm synthesizer pads begins immediately. There are no vocals at the start. (2) A subtle liquid dripping or splashing sound occurs, followed by the entrance of a female voice speaking Mandarin with high clarity and a friendly, professional tone. The music maintains a constant rhythm underneath the speech. (3) Soft, repetitive skin-on-skin rustling sounds are heard as the product is applied to the face. The female narrator explains the product's benefits, such as Vitamin C concentration, with moderate pitch and a calm cadence. (4) The narrator's voice reaches a concluding tone as the rubbing sounds continue. The lo-fi music remains the primary audio floor before both the voice and the music undergo a clean, synchronized fade-out at the end.
